# QS-CFW-5042-83 — Quality specification - valve body CFW-5042-83 (F316)  
Revision: Rev F (This revision supersedes Rev E)  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-5042-83

Scope
- Defines inspection and acceptance criteria for valve body CFW-5042-83 (CFW-5042-83) manufactured from F316 forgings at Plant P3.
- Applies to finished forgings delivered to final machining and assembly.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | F316 (as specified on part drawing) |
| Hardness | The hardness range for valve body CFW-5042-83 (CFW-5042-83) is 33-38 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for valve body CFW-5042-83 (CFW-5042-83) is ±0.06 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for valve body CFW-5042-83 (CFW-5042-83) is 61.8 kg. |
| Surface condition | Free of cracks, laps, and scale that affect fit or function |

Inspection method
- Visual inspection: Inspect for surface discontinuities and scale using standard shop lighting and magnification as required for clear identification.
- Hardness testing: Verify hardness per the requirement using a calibrated Rockwell tester; record location and reading on the inspection record.
- Dimensional inspection: Measure bore diameter with calibrated gage(s) to confirm tolerance. Record nominal and measured values on the inspection record.
- Weight verification: Confirm forging weight against shipment or pack list; record measured weight.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part failing to meet the hardness, bore tolerance, or weight requirement is nonconforming and must be segregated.
- Initiate a nonconformance report and notify Quality. Containment must prevent use in production or shipment.
- Disposition of nonconforming parts shall follow Plant P3 quality procedures. Corrective action shall address root cause before return to production.
